name: Attendance-custom_late_entry
label: Late Entry (mins)
description: Minutes late compared to shift start (rounded to nearest minute). Auto-calculated on save.

name: Attendance-custom_early_entry
label: Early Entry (mins)
description: Minutes early compared to shift start (rounded to nearest minute). Auto-calculated on save.

name: Attendance-custom_early_exit
label: Early Exit (mins)
description: Minutes early compared to shift end (rounded to nearest minute). Auto-calculated on save.

name: Attendance-custom_late_exit
label: Late Exit (mins)
description: Minutes late compared to shift end (rounded to nearest minute). Auto-calculated on save.

name: Shift Type-custom_compensatory_leave_offset_days
label: Compensatory Leave Offset Days
description: Number of days after the holiday to create a Leave Application when employee works on a holiday. Leave blank or 0 to disable.
